title: Bilge-Pump Run Frequency Leak Watch
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bilge:event event=pump_on
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as cycles by _time
| eventstats avg(cycles) as base, stdev(cycles) as sd
| eval leak_suspect=if(cycles>base+3*sd,1,0)
| where leak_suspect=1
description: Watches how often the bilge pump runs and alerts when the rate spikes, an early sign the boat is taking on water.
value: A bilge pump cycling far more than usual is the classic early warning of a leak that could sink a boat.
implementation: Ingest bilge-pump events into `index=personal`; alert on an abnormal run rate.
visualization: Time chart of bilge-pump cycles with a leak-alert band.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how often the bilge pump runs and warns if it spikes, an early sign the boat is leaking.
